Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles From molecule_dictionary Join compound_records On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno Join docs On compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1126800' Left Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Order By molecule_chembl_id
